app.name: Coinio
setup.title: Create your account
setup.intro: This server has no account yet. The one you create here is the only one, and you'll use it on every device.
setup.error.invalid: Enter a username and a password of at least {min} characters.
login.title: Sign in to Coinio
login.error.tooMany: Too many attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
login.intro: Enter the username and password you set up for this server.
error.pageTitle: Something went wrong on this page
error.pageBody: The rest of Coinio still works. Try again, or reload if the problem stays.
dashboard.title: Dashboard
logo.title: Logo
logo.tooBig: The file is larger than 512 KB.
logo.hint: Type a name or website and logos appear here. You can also drop an image (PNG, JPG, WebP, SVG, ICO, up to 512 KB).
form.name: Name
form.autoPayHint: Marked as paid on its due date. Turn off if you pay it yourself.
form.variableHint: The amount is an estimate (~). Enter the real one when you mark it paid.
form.activeHint: Paused subscriptions are left out of totals and reminders.
confirm.deleteBody: Its payment history is deleted too. This can't be undone.
greet.nothingLeft: nothing left to pay this month
month.stale: Exchange rates are not up to date; amounts are approximate.
upcoming.title: Upcoming payments
empty.noSubsBody: Add one and it shows up here with its next payment date.
empty.firstBody: Type a service name or website. For 161 common services the logo, category and billing cycle fill in.
pay.title: Mark {name} as paid
pay.description: Enter what was actually paid, or leave it as it is.
pay.actualHint: Optional. The real amount after conversion.
calendar.emptyBody: Add a subscription and its payment days show up here, months ahead.
reports.intro: Your subscription spending over the last 12 months, this month and the next 12.
reports.emptyBody: Once you add subscriptions, your monthly spending and its breakdown show up here.
quick.title: Quick add
quick.hint: Starts today; change the rest later.
week.title: This week
dist.title: Monthly breakdown
activity.title: Recent activity
all.title: All subscriptions
subs.search: Search by name, website or category
history.title: Payment history
settings.baseCurrencyHint: Totals are shown in this currency; other currencies are converted with daily rates.
settings.timezoneHint: "Today", automatic payments and reminders follow this zone.
notify.desc: A daily Telegram message about upcoming and overdue payments.
notify.tokenHint: From @BotFather. Leave empty to keep the saved one.
notify.chatHint: The chat or group the bot writes to.
notify.notConfigured: Enter a bot token and chat ID first.
notify.testFailed: Telegram did not accept the message. Check the token and chat ID.
keys.desc: For Claude Code, Cursor and the iPhone widget. A new key is shown only once.
keys.name: Key name
keys.copyNow: Copy this key now. It won't be shown again.
keys.revokeBody: Apps using this key stop working right away.
keys.readDesc: See subscriptions and payments. For the widget and assistants that only answer questions.
keys.fullDesc: Also add, change and delete subscriptions and record payments.
apps.desc: Apps you signed in to with your Coinio account, such as claude.ai and the Claude mobile app.
apps.disconnectBody: It loses access until you connect it again.
conn.mcpDesc: Claude, ChatGPT and other assistants can read and update your subscriptions through this address.
conn.claudeAi: In Claude, open Settings › Connectors › Add custom connector, paste the address above and sign in with your Coinio account.
conn.keyHint: Use a full access key if the assistant should add or change subscriptions.
conn.widgetDesc: Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets through the free Scriptable app.
conn.noKey: No key needed: you sign in once
conn.codeHint: Run this in a terminal, with an API key in place of the placeholder.
conn.desktopHint: Add this to the client's MCP settings (mcp.json), with an API key in place of the placeholder.
conn.widgetStep1: Install Scriptable from the App Store.
conn.widgetStep2: Create a Read only key under API keys above and copy it.
conn.widgetStep3: In Scriptable, add a new script, paste coinio-widget.js and fill in the server address and key.
conn.widgetStep4: Add a Scriptable widget to the Home Screen or Lock Screen and choose the script.
import.desc: Bring your subscriptions over from Wallos.
import.badFile: This file could not be read as a Wallos export.

import.found.one: {n} subscription found. Check it, then import.
import.found.other: {n} subscriptions found. Check them, then import.

account.tooShort: The new password is too short.
account.othersOut: Other devices are signed out when you change it.
export.title: Export
look.accentDesc: Buttons, highlights and the chart line.
look.typeDesc: Fonts for headings, amounts and text.
look.cardsDesc: Drag or use the arrows to reorder; the switch shows or hides a card.
look.htmlDesc: Put your own content on the dashboard: notes, links, a widget.
look.htmlSafety: Each card runs in its own sealed frame. It can't reach your account, and it sees your data only if you turn that on for the card.
look.cssDesc: Applied live on top of everything. Override the variables on the right or style anything.
look.shareDesc: Save your appearance as a file or load someone else's.
look.importError: This file could not be read as a theme.
look.safeMode: Custom CSS and HTML cards are off for this visit (the address has ?nocss). Fix them here, then reload without it.
look.cssEscape: If your CSS hides the app, add ?nocss to the address (for example /settings/appearance?nocss) to load it without custom CSS and HTML cards.
look.importBody: It replaces your current appearance, including your HTML cards and custom CSS.

look.importCode.one: This file contains custom CSS and {n} HTML card. Cards can run scripts in their sealed frame and CSS can change how anything looks. Load it only if you trust where it came from.
look.importCode.other: This file contains custom CSS and {n} HTML cards. Cards can run scripts in their sealed frame and CSS can change how anything looks. Load it only if you trust where it came from.

look.resetAllBody: Theme, fonts, colours, card layout, custom CSS and HTML cards go back to the defaults.
look.htmlDeleteBody: The card and its code are removed from the dashboard. This can't be undone.
look.htmlShare: Show my data to this card
look.htmlShareDesc: The card receives a read-only summary: totals and upcoming payments.
look.htmlShareTitle: Show your data to this card?
look.htmlShareWarning: The card's code will be able to read your upcoming payments, amounts and totals, and it could send them elsewhere. Turn this on only for code you wrote or trust.

totals.excluded.one: {n} subscription not in the total (no exchange rate)
totals.excluded.other: {n} subscriptions not in the total (no exchange rate)

welcome.title: Choose your language
welcome.intro: Three quick steps and Coinio is ready. You can change all of this later in Settings.
welcome.basicsIntro: Totals are shown in your main currency. Other currencies are converted daily at the current rate.
welcome.zoneHint: Detected from this device. "Today" and reminders follow it.
welcome.startTitle: How do you want to start?
welcome.startIntro: Pick one. Sample data can be cleared with one click.
welcome.wallosBody: Bring your subscriptions over from a Wallos export file.
welcome.samplesBody: Eight realistic subscriptions, so you can see how everything works.
welcome.emptyBody: Add your first subscription yourself. Common services fill in their logo and billing cycle.
welcome.steps.basicsDesc: So totals and reminders come out right
welcome.steps.startDesc: Sample data, a clean start or an import
welcome.zoneHintManual: "Today" and reminders follow this time zone.
demo.locked: Not available in the demo. This part needs Coinio running on your own server.
auth.brand.headline: Every subscription, one calm page.
auth.brand.lede: See what renews next in any currency, on a server you own.
auth.preview.title: Up next
auth.password.hint: At least {min} characters. A short sentence works well.
auth.password.short: Too short. Use at least {min} characters.
auth.password.score2: Fair. A few more characters make it stronger.
cardMenu.label: {name}: card options
